kelify_create_conversation.name: kelify_create_conversation
kelify_create_conversation.description: Create a new conversation session for property search. Each conversation maintains context across multiple messages, allowing for natural follow-up questions.

kelify_send_message.name: kelify_send_message
kelify_send_message.description: Send a user message to a conversation and receive an AI response with property search results. Can use streaming or non-streaming mode.

params.conversation_id: The conversation UUID to send the message to
params.message: The user's message to the AI assistant for property search
params.stream: Whether to stream the response. Default is true.

kelify_get_conversation.name: kelify_get_conversation
kelify_get_conversation.description: Retrieve full conversation history including all messages, AI responses, search results, and usage statistics.

name: Kelify AI Property Search
description: AI-powered conversational property search API for real estate listings

changelog.notes: Initial release — search real estate listings through AI conversations, with follow-up questions and full chat history
